valveProducts.title: Bolted Side Piece Cast Steel Ball Valve (Class 150# - 600#)
valveProducts.meta: 2 & 3-Piece, Side Entry / Split Body, Fire Safe, Anti-static & Blow-out Proof Stem, Floating & Trunnion type Ball design. Full bore or reduced bore with live-loaded multiple V-Teflon packing.

standards.std: ASTM A216 WCB / A351 CF8 / CF8M

bom.mat1: PTFE / CFT / GFT / VITON / Spiral Wound

valveProducts.title: Bolted Bonnet Cast Carbon & Stainless Steel Gate Valve (2" - 24")
valveProducts.meta: Flexible wedge with centre stem-wedge contact in solid CA15 (13Cr) or hand faced with SS 316, Monel, or CoCr alloy. Non-rotating burnished acme stem with one-piece bonnet up to NPS 12.

bom.mat1: A 439 Austenitic Ductile Iron Gr. D-2C

valveProducts.title: Bolted Bonnet Cast Steel Globe Valve (2" - 24")
valveProducts.meta: Tapered plug disc accurately mates with hard-faced seat (13% Cr, CoCr alloy, or Monel). Precision non-rotating burnished double acme stem with renewable austenitic ductile iron stem nut.

valveProducts.title: Bolted Bonnet Cast Steel Swing Check Valve (2" - 24")
valveProducts.meta: One-piece non-rotating disc fastened to sturdy disc hanger with lock nut and cotter pin. Hard-faced with 13% Cr or CoCr alloy, ground and lapped with seat. Full top-cover accessibility.

valveProducts.title: Retainerless Wafer Dual Plate Check Valve (2" - 24")
valveProducts.meta: Retainerless wafer design supplied as standard, conforming to API 594 face-to-face dimensions and ANSI B16.5 flanges. Spring-assisted closure eliminates water hammer and reverse surges.

valveProducts.title: Single Plate Thin Wafer Check Valve (DN32 - DN600)
valveProducts.meta: Compact wafer single plate check valve suitable for water, sewage, and natural liquid lines. Large opening angle and low head loss with optional spring-assisted return.

valveProducts.title: High-Performance Cast Steel Butterfly Valve (1 1/2" - 28")
valveProducts.meta: Slim Seal, Wafer Type, Double Flanged, Double & Triple Eccentric. 100% tight shut-off in both flow directions with replaceable/molded rubber seats (EPDM/Nitrile/Viton/PTFE/PFA). Universal mounting (ANSI/BS/DIN/JIS).

valveProducts.title: "MESCO" Heavy-Duty Knife Edge Gate Valve (50mm - 600mm)
valveProducts.meta: Batten knife-edge gate cuts through dense flowing media and abrasive slurries, ensuring tight shut-off even when solid particles settle at the bottom. Non-sliding contact prevents wear. Widely used in Mining, Power, Steel, Chemical, Paper, and Coal Ash.

standards.std: ANSI B16.5, DIN, BS, JIS, AS Standard

valveProducts.title: MESCO Pulp & Slurry Plate Valve (DN50 - DN400)
valveProducts.meta: Unrestricted smooth flow of viscous fluids. Recess-free straight passage orifice minimizes body contact and avoids accumulation of solids, ensuring unaltered velocity. Designed for Sugar molasses, paper stock lines, cement hoppers, and coal ash slurries.

valveProducts.title: High-Pressure Forged Steel Gate Valve (Class 800# - 2500#)
valveProducts.meta: Compact forged gate valve conforming to API 602 and ASME B16.34. Available with Bolted Bonnet or Welded Bonnet. Socket weld, screwed NPT, butt-weld, or integral flanged ends.

valveProducts.title: High-Pressure Forged Steel Globe Valve (Class 800# - 2500#)
valveProducts.meta: API 602 / ISO 15761 forged globe valve engineered for severe high-pressure throttling and thermal power isolation. Bolted or welded bonnet with renewable Stellite seating surfaces.

valveProducts.title: High-Pressure Forged Piston & Ball Check Valve (Class 800# - 2500#)
valveProducts.meta: API 602 / ISO 15761 forged check valve with bolted or welded cover. Rapid closure prevents fluid shock and backflow in high-pressure steam, oil, and gas lines.

valveProducts.title: 3-Piece Forged & Flanged Ball Valve (Class 800# / 150# - 600#)
valveProducts.meta: ISO 17292 3-piece bolted body ball valve allowing inline swing-out maintenance without disturbing piping connections. Precision mirror-buffed ball with zero-leakage PTFE/CFT seats.

valveProducts.title: Industrial Cast & Forged Y-Type Strainer (Class 150# - 1500#)
valveProducts.meta: Low pressure drop streamlined design with large stainless steel strainer screens. Protects downstream pumps, meters, and valves from foreign particles and pipeline debris.

valveProducts.title: Simplex & Continuous Flow Duplex Strainers (Class 125# - 600#)
valveProducts.meta: Offset and inline basket housing with mesh or wedge-wire lining. Swing-bolt quick element changeout. Duplex models allow continuous fluid flow without system shutdown during basket cleaning.

workstations.name: 5-Axis Heavy Machining Center
workstations.desc: High-torque multi-axis machining centers for precision boring, flange facing, and seat contouring of 2" to 24" cast and forged valve bodies.

workstations.name: CNC Spindle & Stem Turning Cell
workstations.desc: Heavy-duty CNC lathes producing burnished acme valve stems, trunnion shafts, and micro-lapped balls with zero run-out.

workstations.name: CMM 3D Metrology & Flange Inspection
workstations.desc: Volumetric laser and touch-probe CMM validating bolt circle PCD, flange thickness, and wall tolerances against ASME B16.34.

workstations.name: Hydrostatic & Helium Leak Testing Bay
workstations.desc: Multi-station high-pressure test benches executing 1.5x hydrostatic shell tests and bubble-tight helium seat leakage certification.
